item.title: Paramount’s revised Warner Bros bid fails to sway key shareholders
item.description: Paramount Skydance’s revised takeover bid for Warner Bros Discovery has failed to fully win over key shareholders, despite significant changes to its financing structure. Harris Oakmark, Warner Bros’ fifth-largest shareholder with a 4% stake, said the updated offer was “necessary, but not sufficient” and indicated it would hold out for better terms, according to a report by Reuters. On December 22, Paramount amended its US$108.4 billion hostile bid to address investor concerns around financing.
